title: Check Tipper Process Status and Send/Pause Controls on the VISU_DATA Screen
summary: On the Operator Station HMI (VISU_DATA screen), verify the tipper Process Status indicators (green states) and use the VISU_DATA controls to send a tote to the hospital (SEND LEFT TO HOSPITAL / SEND RIGHT TO HOSPITAL) or pause both tippers (PAUSE TIPPER).
when_to_use: Use when you need to (1) confirm the current tipper process state indicators on the VISU_DATA screen and (2) send the tote at the left or right tipper to the hospital, or pause both tippers.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Navigate to the VISU_DATA screen, verify Process Status indicators, and use SEND LEFT/RIGHT TO HOSPITAL or PAUSE TIPPER controls as appropriate.
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU (Operator Station HMI)

access_required: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU (Operator Station HMI)
system_preconditions: VISU_DATA screen is available on the Operator Station HMI.

steps.title: Open the Operator Station HMI and navigate to the VISU_DATA screen
steps.purpose: Access the Process Status indicators and the manual controls for sending totes to the hospital or pausing both tippers.
steps.instruction: On the Operator Station HMI, open the VISU_DATA screen (Operator Station HMI Data Screen).
steps.expected_result: The VISU_DATA screen is displayed, including the Process Status section and the buttons SEND LEFT TO HOSPITAL, SEND RIGHT TO HOSPITAL, and PAUSE TIPPER.
steps.healthy_condition: VISU_DATA screen elements are visible and readable, including the Process Status indicators and the three controls.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot see the Process Status section or the SEND LEFT/RIGHT TO HOSPITAL and PAUSE TIPPER buttons on the screen.

actions.label: Navigate to VISU_DATA
actions.exact_action: Navigate to the "VISU_DATA" screen (Operator Station HMI Data Screen).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: VISU_DATA screen includes the Process Status section and controls: SEND LEFT TO HOSPITAL, SEND RIGHT TO HOSPITAL, and PAUSE TIPPER.

steps.title: Verify green Process Status indicators in the Process Status section
steps.purpose: Confirm the tipper’s current operational state before using send/pause controls.
steps.instruction: In the Process Status section, observe the green status indicators for: In Cycle (Auto mode), Tipper Ready, AGV Present, Tip in Process, Tipper Clear, and Tipper Faulted.
steps.expected_result: The Process Status indicators show green states corresponding to the current tipper process state (as defined by the VISU_DATA Process Status indicators).
steps.healthy_condition: The relevant indicators you intend to rely on for the action are green (e.g., In Cycle is green when operating in Auto mode; Tipper Ready is green when ready to receive a tote; Tip in Process is green when the gripper has a tote; Tipper Clear is green when the gripper is open; Tipper Faulted is green if the tipper currently has a fault).
steps.failure_condition: The Process Status indicators do not match the intended action state (e.g., the tipper is not in the expected ready/clear/in-process state, or the tipper faulted state is not consistent with what you are attempting).

actions.label: Check Process Status indicators
actions.exact_action: Observe the Process Status indicators (In Cycle, Tipper Ready, AGV Present, Tip in Process, Tipper Clear, Tipper Faulted).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and do not continue using send/pause controls if the Process Status indicators do not match the expected green states for the intended action (e.g., tipper not ready / not in the expected state).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Process Status indicators and meanings: In Cycle (green if operating in Auto mode), Tipper Ready (green if ready to receive a tote), AGV Present (green if a robot is stationed at the tipper), Tip in Process (green when gripper takes hold of a tote until released), Tipper Clear (green when gripper is open), Tipper Faulted (green if tipper currently has a fault).

steps.title: Send the tote at the left tipper to the hospital
steps.purpose: Divert the tote currently at the left tipper to the hospital using the VISU_DATA control.
steps.instruction: If a tote is currently at the left tipper and needs to be sent to the hospital, press SEND LEFT TO HOSPITAL.
steps.expected_result: Pressing SEND LEFT TO HOSPITAL initiates sending the tote at the left tipper to the hospital.
steps.healthy_condition: The Process Status indicators are consistent with the action (e.g., the left side is in the appropriate state such that a tote is present/in process and the tipper is ready/appropriate per the Process Status indicator meanings).
steps.failure_condition: The Process Status indicators do not match the expected green states for sending (e.g., tipper not ready / not in the expected state), or you observe a mismatch after pressing.

actions.label: Send left tote to hospital
actions.exact_action: Press the SEND LEFT TO HOSPITAL button.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and do not continue using send/pause controls if the Process Status indicators do not match the expected green states for the intended action.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: SEND LEFT TO HOSPITAL button will send the tote currently at the left tipper to the hospital.

steps.title: Send the tote at the right tipper to the hospital
steps.purpose: Divert the tote currently at the right tipper to the hospital using the VISU_DATA control.
steps.instruction: If a tote is currently at the right tipper and needs to be sent to the hospital, press SEND RIGHT TO HOSPITAL.
steps.expected_result: Pressing SEND RIGHT TO HOSPITAL initiates sending the tote at the right tipper to the hospital.
steps.healthy_condition: The Process Status indicators are consistent with the action (e.g., the right side is in the appropriate state such that a tote is present/in process and the tipper is ready/appropriate per the Process Status indicator meanings).
steps.failure_condition: The Process Status indicators do not match the expected green states for sending (e.g., tipper not ready / not in the expected state), or you observe a mismatch after pressing.

actions.label: Send right tote to hospital
actions.exact_action: Press the SEND RIGHT TO HOSPITAL button.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and do not continue using send/pause controls if the Process Status indicators do not match the expected green states for the intended action.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: SEND RIGHT TO HOSPITAL button will send the tote currently at the right tipper to the hospital.

steps.title: Pause both tippers
steps.purpose: Temporarily stop tipper activity when needed.
steps.instruction: If you need to pause both tippers, press PAUSE TIPPER.
steps.expected_result: Pressing PAUSE TIPPER pauses both tippers.
steps.healthy_condition: You have verified Process Status indicators are in a state consistent with pausing (and you are not attempting send actions when indicators do not match expected states).
steps.failure_condition: Process Status indicators do not match the expected green states for the intended action, or pausing does not occur as expected.
stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and do not continue using send/pause controls if the Process Status indicators do not match the expected green states for the intended action.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: PAUSE TIPPER button will pause both tippers.

success_criteria: Process Status indicators on VISU_DATA show the expected green meanings for the intended action.
SEND LEFT TO HOSPITAL or SEND RIGHT TO HOSPITAL is used only when the intended tipper state is consistent with the Process Status indicators.
PAUSE TIPPER is used to pause both tippers when needed.
healthy_conditions: In Cycle indicator is green when the tipper is operating in Auto mode.
Tipper Ready indicator is green when ready to receive a tote.
AGV Present indicator is green when a robot is currently stationed at the tipper.
Tip in Process indicator is green when the gripper takes hold of a tote and remains green until the tote is released.
Tipper Clear indicator is green when the gripper is open.
Tipper Faulted indicator is green if the tipper currently has a fault.
failure_conditions: Process Status indicators do not match the expected green states for the intended action (e.g., tipper not ready / not in the expected state).
Tipper Faulted indicator is green when you are attempting an action that requires a non-faulted state (mismatch between intended action and observed indicator state).
escalation_guidance: If the Process Status indicators do not show the expected green states for the action you are attempting (e.g., tipper not ready / faulted state not reflected), stop using the send/pause controls and escalate per site procedure.
